name: deskdock
description: Let Claude safely operate any Windows app: windows read as text, click/type/keys, per-app permissions, audit log, OCR fallback, macros.
long_description: DeskDock gives Claude hands on the Windows desktop. It lists windows, reads their controls as text (UI Automation) so clicks target controls rather than pixels, types and presses keys, and falls back to the built-in Windows OCR for apps without a UI tree. Every app has a permission level (block / read / click / full) that you edit in a local control panel, every call is written to an audit log you can replay, and repeated tasks can be saved as macros that appear as new tools. Windows 10/11 only.
